title: verbascum phlomoides var. nothum
intro: Verbascum phlomoides var. nothum, commonly known as a variable mullein, is a plant species in the figwort family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting mucous membranes, and as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum phlomoides var. nothum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
